# Hermes Agent: Getting Started FAQ & Reference Guide

This guide answers common questions regarding configuration, model setups, messaging gateways, tools, and troubleshooting in Hermes Agent.

---

### 1. Installation & System Support

* **Does Hermes support native Windows?**
  Yes. Windows 10/11 is a Tier 1 supported platform via the PowerShell installer (`install.ps1`). WSL2 is only needed if you require the POSIX PTY embedded terminal in the web dashboard.
* **How do I deploy on Docker / NAS (Synology, UGOS, unRAID)?**
  Official images support multi-arch (`linux/amd64` and `linux/arm64` / Raspberry Pi). To avoid volume `[Errno 13] Permission denied` errors on bind mounts, pass `PUID` and `PGID` (e.g., `PUID=1000`, `PGID=10`) as environment variables.
* **Can I run Hermes on Android Termux?**
  Yes. The installer automatically detects Termux, sets `ANDROID_API_LEVEL`, and installs curated `termux-all` dependencies with writable `TMPDIR` paths.
* **Is there a Web UI?**
  Yes. Run `hermes dashboard` to launch the local web server and open the browser chat interface at `http://127.0.0.1:9119`.

---

### 2. Model Providers & LLM Configuration

* **Why is Hermes using Anthropic/OpenAI API instead of my local Ollama?**
  When `provider: auto` is set, Hermes scans your environment for API keys (e.g., `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`). To force local inference, set `provider: custom` in `~/.hermes/config.yaml`:
  ```yaml
  model:
    default: ollama/your-model
    provider: custom
    base_url: http://localhost:11434
  ```
* **Why are small local models (4B–9B) slow?**
  Hermes passes the full tool schema (~45 tools) on each turn. For better local performance:
  - Disable unused toolsets with `hermes tools`.
  - Use 32B+ models or higher-speed quantization for tool-heavy workflows.
  - Set `terminal.backend: local`.
* **How do I configure Azure AI Foundry or Ollama Cloud?**
  - **Azure Foundry:** Run `hermes setup` or set `provider: azure-foundry` (auto-detects `ANTHROPIC_FOUNDRY_BASE_URL`).
  - **Ollama Cloud:** Use the built-in `ollama-cloud` provider which routes to `https://ollama.com/v1`.
* **How can I use Claude Pro/Max subscription rather than API credits?**
  Authenticate using Claude OAuth rather than an API key. Standard API keys always incur per-token API billing.
* **Can I enable vision on custom/local endpoints?**
  Add `supports_vision: true` under your model configuration to send native image payloads instead of text fallbacks.
* **Does Hermes support automatic cheap/smart model routing?**
  No. Complexity-based per-turn auto-routing is not supported by design. Subagents are explicitly configured via `delegation.provider` and `delegation.model`.

---

### 3. Gateways & Messaging Platforms (Discord, Telegram, etc.)

* **How do I set up messaging gateways easily?**
  Run `hermes gateway setup` to launch the interactive configuration wizard for Discord, Telegram, Slack, etc.
* **Why does Telegram reject me with "Unauthorized user"?**
  `allowed_chats` only controls *group* response permissions, not user authorization. To authorize direct messages:
  - Add your numerical user ID to config: `telegram.allow_from: "12345678"`
  - Or approve a pairing code: `hermes pairing approve telegram <CODE>`
  - Or allow public access: `telegram.allow_all: true`
* **Can gateways send and receive files/images?**
  Yes. Inbound `.txt`, `.py`, and media files are accepted. Outbound files and MCP image results are delivered as native attachments (Matrix, Telegram, Discord, Email multipart) or Markdown images (DingTalk).
* **Can I set per-channel personas or multi-account gateways?**
  - **Personas:** Use `channel_prompts` in your gateway config to assign unique system prompts per channel ID.
  - **Multi-user/Multi-account:** Hermes supports multiplexed gateway profiles, isolating memory, credentials, and sessions.

---

### 4. Agent Loops, Autonomy, & Memory

* **What should I do when Hermes hits its "tool-call limit"?**
  Turns default to 90 iterations (`agent.max_turns`). You can override this per run with `hermes chat --max-turns <N>`. For long autonomous workflows, use the persistent Ralph loop: `/goal <task>` and continue paused runs with `/goal resume`.
* **How does memory differ across files?**
  - `SOUL.md`: Defines the agent's persona and core instructions.
  - `USER.md`: Stores persistent user identity/preferences (`target="user"`).
  - `MEMORY.md`: General facts and conversation memory.
  - *Note:* New in-tree memory backends are closed; install custom memory engines as standalone plugins in `~/.hermes/plugins/`.
* **How do I track skill usage and agent traces?**
  - Inspect tool/skill statistics using `hermes insights` or `/insights`.
  - Enable Langfuse execution tracing via `hermes plugins enable observability/langfuse`.

---

### 5. Maintenance & Security

* **Why does `hermes update` appear frozen on Node.js?**
  The Camofox postinstall step downloads browser binaries silently in the background. Allow it a few minutes to complete.
* **How do I report security vulnerabilities?**
  Report responsibly via GitHub Security Advisories or email `security@nousresearch.com` (see `SECURITY.md`). Do not file public issues.
